stats.title: One software bug. [[Six major banks went down.]]
stats.subtitle: A single fault in shared hardware took out the same day's payments at the largest US banks.

quote.text: A temporary issue related to a software bug in an on-premise hardware system, not a cyber attack.

stats.takeaway: Your three biggest competitors can go down together. Your resilience plan needs to assume they will.

flow.title: Every step right. [[Still a double payment.]]

steps.head: Agent retries
steps.body: Same amount, same payee, new request.

steps.head: Pause and escalate
steps.body: Unknown state goes to a human, not a retry.

flow.takeaway: Knowing when not to act matters as much as knowing what to do.

points.title: The model is not [[the whole story]]

points.head: Context and state
points.body: Memory and history decide what the agent knows.

points.head: Control flow
points.body: Planning loops and sub-agents keep it on track.

points.head: Verification
points.body: Tests and checks catch its mistakes early.

points.takeaway: Models become commodities. The system around them is the moat.
